invariants.description: costs and the ATP port balance (exact): J_RNA, J_ribo, J_lipid from their counts; repair; growth
invariants.expr: np.allclose(J_RNA, n_mRNA*L_mRNA*c_nt_recycle*np.log(2)/t_half_mRNA/N_A*f_ATP_bio, rtol=1e-12, atol=0) and np.allclose(J_lipid, 2*A_mem*surface_factor/area_per_lipid*c_lipid*k_lipid/N_A*f_ATP_bio, rtol=1e-12, atol=0) and np.allclose(J_repair, R_repair*C_repair, rtol=1e-12, atol=0) and np.allclose(j_ATP_bio, -J_ATP_bio, rtol=1e-12, atol=0) and np.allclose(j_ADP_bio, J_ATP_bio, rtol=1e-12, atol=0)

invariants.description: growth is asked in multiples of the resting turnover and throttled: J_growth = growth_level J_ref throttle; the daughter costs M_build_bio + M_build_protein; progress = P_growth / M_daughter, glycogen progress = M_glyc_ATP / M_daughter (exact)
invariants.expr: np.allclose(throttle, np.clip((ATP - ATP_floor)/(ATP_ref - ATP_floor), 0, 1), rtol=1e-12, atol=1e-15) and np.allclose(J_growth, growth_level*J_ref*throttle, rtol=1e-12, atol=0) and np.allclose(M_daughter, M_build_bio + M_build_protein, rtol=1e-12, atol=0) and np.allclose(growth_progress, P_growth/M_daughter, rtol=1e-12, atol=1e-15) and np.allclose(glycogen_progress, M_glyc_ATP/M_daughter, rtol=1e-12, atol=1e-15)

invariants.description: the daughter receives exactly the growth ATP spent: P(t) - P(0) = int J_growth_used dt (relative 1e-6)
damage balance: D(t) - D(0) = int (r_dmg f_T - R_repair) dt (relative 1e-6), damage never negative
invariants.expr: abs(D[-1] - D[0] - np.trapz(r_dmg*f_T_dmg - R_repair, t)) <= 1e-6*np.trapz(np.abs(r_dmg*f_T_dmg) + np.abs(R_repair), t) + 1e-15 and np.all(D >= 0)

bc_sweep.rationale: temperatures 0-40 C; repair level and growth over the ranges the game offers
